definitionZh: 初始字母 CSS 属性设置大小和沉积,用于抛放,提升和沉没的初始字母. 该财产适用于区块容器的首字母伪内容和内置一级儿童。
sourceDefinition: The initial-letter CSS property sets the size and sink for dropped, raised, and sunken initial letters. This property applies to ::first-letter pseudo-elements and inline-level first children of block containers.
